decisions.text: Expansion II seeds (see Write Atlas Storyline).

Server stays on rapier2d; terrain height is a value that follows the ground. No combat outcome depends on height (no jump dodge, arcing shots, flying bosses). Bridges and multi-level areas are separate layers with portals; caves and dungeons are separate instances.
Target simulation tick is 30 Hz. Code is still 20 Hz (WORLD_TICK_RATE_HZ in server-rs/src/content/world_model.rs, tick_rate_ms in server-rs/src/main.rs); changing it is a separate feature.
Walkable slope limit is 35 degrees on both server and client; steeper is a cliff wall that slides movement along the contour.

Player persistence uses only the built-in Rust meta engine (RustMetaEngine + SqliteMetaStore). Nakama is removed. Cleanup order: client MetaGateway moves to the Rust meta HTTP API; delete the server Nakama path and its tests; delete nakama/, k8s nakama and cockroachdb files, docker-compose entries and the Nakama CI gate; update docs.

decisions.text: Does the player's first trip Maro Bell -> Kilnwatch Bastion cross a defined number of zones or distance? Transcript states it is undefined.
Where exactly are Linde Glaze, Daro Post and Silme Echo (homeland geography undefined; position of Linde explicitly not set)?

Is Silme Deep fully underground? Where do rivers flow, where are mountain passes, which towns produce food and which import resources, and do the Great Kilns reshape terrain? (ChatGPT listed these as needed answers; no owner answer.)
Launch scope: must all six race prologues ship together with Ch 0-II, or does Maro Bell go first? ChatGPT asked for explicit owner confirmation.
Approve the Heart/Spark/Scar casts of the five towns other than Maro Bell (names Torren, Hald, Fenn, Sera, Rook, Vessa, Nelli, Oren etc. remain proposals) and the five missing race prologues.
Which race hooks are fixed vs player-selectable? ChatGPT said players should be able to choose a different motive; not answered.
Map scope for six starter-town layouts, Kilnwatch Bastion and Ch 0-II zone maps: approve?
World size/centres: ChatGPT asked 'one civilisation centre or several equal cities'; owner replied only 'Okei' after the Polycentric leaning, no explicit decision.
Level pacing vs shared towns: how do high-level players return to low-level towns without breaking pacing (Living World layers 1-3)? Left as design principle, no owner decision on mechanics.
Distinguish 'regions' from 'kiln regions' and hub locations in the Game DB (canon card shows nine entries).
Mixed-race ratios per town: ChatGPT proposed no fixed ratios; no owner answer.
After each race prologue (Lv 10) the first trip to Kilnwatch is a one-way guided caravan; walking stays possible.
